stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The box was not a real vault, but it made the idea personal.”?
options: It is also about how to keep it readable.
Saving seeds was also saving choices for tomorrow's meals.
It is also about what happens along the way.
It is also about protecting someone's dignity while giving.
